title: Nice for frozen foods too
text: Nice for frozen foods too. I got this to keep in my car for when I buy frozen foods on warm days. I just put 1 regular ice pk in it and it stays very cold inside and keeps the food frozen. Nice to carry. Not too big to handle

product_metadata.title: 519 Fitness Tactical Lunch Bag, 20L Large Lunch Box for Men,Heavy Duty Insulated Lunchbox Reusable Lunch Tote with Molle, Leakproof Meal Prep Cooler for Work,Camping,Fishing,Travel(brown)
features: LARGER CAPACITY: 519 Fitness Larger Lunch box size in 13" x 10" x 9" (L*W*H), 20L capacity, spacious fits 3-4 adult sized meal prep containers, 18 cans or 12 beer bottles, built with a zippered front pocket, one side pockets with molle, one mesh side pocket, one big zippered mesh bag in the inner top for easy access for urgent situation. A velcro in the front pocket area can patch different patches you like. The lunch cooler is equipped with total 5 compartments to pack bottles,lunch box, sandwich, drinks and fruits for outdoor work.

DURABLE & HEAVY DUTY: All lunch box materials have experienced rigorous quality control (CA65 AND REACH). You will be equipped with family-safe, durable, eco-friendly, soft materials including water-resistant dirt-proof high density 1000D polyester fabric and 100% leakproof aluminum inner lining to protect you from leaks and spills.Both shoulder strap and handle are double stitched with a load-bearing of 50BL.The shoulder strap is double layered with one side leather and one side oxford fabric, which ensure it more durable and attractive.

LONG-TIME INSULATION: Our tactical lunch box insulated with 4 layers insulation material to provide excellent cold/warm preservation,constructed with ultra-thick 10mm PE foam core insulation technology to keep your food cold or warm up to 8-10 hours with the our extra gift icepack.

SPECIAL MOLLE SYSTEM: Tactical cooler designed with military style including MOLLE/PALS webbing on the rear and side, very tough lunch bag providing extra storage for keys , pouches, carabiners. Designed for trucks, troops, airport, construction etc.

EASY TO CLEAN: The outer material is dust-proof and water resistant and easy to clean, and the inner lining is customized seamless aluminum foil, you can wipe gently with a paper towel or damp cloth to clean. Considered longer lifetime of the lunchbag, you can hand wash instead of machine washing.

3 WAY HANDLING- With 70 Inches long adjustable shoulder strap, reinforced handle, or MOLLE system to detach to your meal prep bag. Convenient and easy carrying as outdoor lunch tote. It can not only serve as a lunchbox for work, but can be a lunch bag for outdoor activities like fishing,camping, picnic, beach and more..
